author: wyliemason1614
body:
So today i was playing on a server
I typed in Mineoria.net is a fun factions server
Then I came on AV and i was playing Quintus 
I said something that i wanted to repeat so I used the Up Arrow key
Little did i know when I clicked enter, Mineoria.net is a fun server was entered and i was permanently banned. 
Conclusion
I a very sad i have been playing on this server for like 4 years or 3 years. I didn't mean to advertise (I promise) and I was banned for life
It sucks so if any mod reads this i just want them to know i am very very sorry :(

Sincerely,
                wyliemason1614

replies.author: gobernment
replies.body:
Looking at your logs, you said quite a bit before your ban, which makes me think that the "repeat" thing was invalid. Counting since the session you were on, you said 42 different things. Unless you scrolled up through your messages 42 times to get an entry from before you logged on, I don't honestly believe this.

Could you provide a more rational explanation?

replies.author: gobernment
replies.body: Advertising, at least in your context, is a permanent ban. We do not provide warnings or kicks to advertising unless it's in reply to someone else, or was a true accident.

replies.author: MidnightBeats
replies.body:
Hello.

Your logs tell a different story. After a little research, I noticed that you only mentioned the IP once (Vice noticed the same thing), indicating that you intentionally advertised the server and that you did not press the "Up-Arrow key" to repeat what you said. 

You will not be appealed.

Regards,
MidnightBeats
Administrator
